note: Pegboard Seven runtime settings. Edited here and deployed with the site; a player picks them up on their next launch. A key absent here falls back to the value shipped in the build. Every value below equals the shipped default on purpose: this file documents the knobs and changes nothing until a value is edited. Editors: the game finds a block by searching for its quoted name so no note may contain a block name in quotes; no value may contain a comma.
ads: Interstitial pacing is fail-first. failFromLevel and winFromLevel are 1-based levels. failFreeAttempts losses on a level show no ad; every later loss does until failStuckAfter; past that only every failStuckEvery-th loss. Wins show one every winEvery wins and never within winQuietAfterFailAd active seconds of a fail ad. minActiveSeconds is active play between any two full-screen ads. rewardedSkipsNext lets a watched rewarded ad pay for the next interstitial. Change ads.tag with every pacing change so analytics can tell the tunings apart.
experiment: The share block is empty so every install is on the first tuning. Give a named tuning a share to start an experiment; the assignment is stable per install.
